preconditions.description: The number of pairs of vertices n is between 2 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w[i] <= 10**12 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each weight w_{i, i+1} connecting odd and even vertices is between 1 and 10^12 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x[i] <= n and 1 <= y[i] <= n and x[i] != y[i] for i in range(n-1))
preconditions.description: Each pair (x_i, y_i) of vertices for the edges between odd and odd, even and even vertices is valid and x_i is not equal to y_i.
Each weight w_{i,1} and w_{i,2} for the edges between odd and odd, even and even vertices is between 1 and 10^12 inclusive.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 600,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u[i] <= 2*n and 1 <= v[i] <= 2*n and u[i] != v[i] for i in range(q))
preconditions.description: Each query (u_i, v_i) is valid and u_i is not equal to v_i.

postconditions.description: The number of answers is equal to the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(answer, int) for answer in answers)
all(0 <= answer <= 2 * 10**12 for answer in answers)
postconditions.description: Each answer is between 0 and 2 * 10^12 inclusive.
